input.question: Why is it that I hear about people in the past dying of the common cold while I'm able to beat the common cold with no medication and/or major symptoms?
input.ground_truth: You probably have a balanced diet and aren't missing any nutrients. You also probably have a warm home and don't work in the fields every day. Bottom line, our lives are less stressful and we have better food than our ancestors.

But now, we know about cold bugs! We also know how to help your body fight them. You eat good food, drink water, and sometimes you rest. Your body is really good at fighting these bugs by itself, especially when you’re healthy. That’s why you can beat a cold without medicine and don’t get very sick.

So, people in the past got very sick from colds because they didn’t know how to help their bodies fight the bugs, but now we do!
